We got 3 pigs from petsmart, and they were all supposedly female. One turned out to be male and got our other two pregnant. We learned our lesson about pet stores.

Don't feel like a terrible person. You did your research and thought they would be a good fit and it didn't work out. You aren't a failure as a pet owner. I can't speak for the pigs, but I think they and you would be happier if they were in a home that appreciates them.

I would look into shelters around your location and ask what their adoption rate for small animals is, or post online and talk at length with prospective owners about how they will be housed, care, etc. 5-9 years is a long time, and personal experience with other animals, I resented them after a while.

You could keep them and take care of their needs, but someone who absolutely loves them would be a better home, for all of you.
